one_liner: Entry-level Air Force management analyst trainee doing workforce, process, and manpower studies, with a path from GS-7 to GS-11 at bases nationwide.
fit_summary: Daniel's consulting work at IEM for government clients could translate into analysis, interviewing, and stakeholder-communication skills the posting values. However, this is a Direct-Hire notice for current post-secondary students and recent graduates (degree within two years of appointment), and Daniel's education and graduation date are not on file. Eligibility hinges on that, plus GS-7 education or GS-5-level specialized experience.
eligibility: Limited to current post-secondary students and recent graduates, meaning a degree awarded no more than two years before appointment (longer only for 4+ years of uniformed service). Confirm when Daniel graduated.

GS-7 qualification requires one of these: 1 year of graduate education, a bachelor's with Superior Academic Achievement (upper third, GPA 2.95+ overall or 3.45+ in major, or a national honor society), or 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to GS-5.
Transcripts must be submitted if qualifying on education, plus documentation of class standing or honor society membership if used.
Secret clearance is required, and the posting states there is a 1-year probationary or 2-year trial period.
No telework or remote work; locations are Air Force-wide, so Daniel must be willing to work at the base where a vacancy occurs.
keywords: conducting interviews with supervisors and employees
strategy: First confirm the recent-graduate window and Superior Academic Achievement (GPA, class rank, or honor society); if Daniel doesn't qualify, skip this notice and target public-notice GS-7/9 analyst roles instead.

Frame the IEM role around what Daniel actually did that matches the posting, such as research, data gathering, client interviews, reports, and planning support for government emergency-management programs. Use the posting's exact wording where it is truthful.
Keep the resume to two pages. For the IEM job, list exact start and end dates (month/year) and hours per week, and put the specialized experience in the first bullets.
Upload unofficial transcripts and any SAA proof with the application; missing documents make the application ineligible.
Prepare for HireVue assessments and recorded interviews that test communication, problem solving, planning, and willingness to learn. Practice concise STAR answers on camera.
This is an open-continuous notice running through 2027-09-30, so apply early and indicate preferred locations near Manassas (e.g., the Pentagon or Joint Base Andrews) if they are listed.
resume_bullets: Gathered and analyzed [type of data] for [government client/program] at IEM, identifying [trends/issues] and drafting recommendations in [deliverable] for [audience].
Conducted interviews with [number] [client staff/supervisors] to document organizational missions, functions, and work procedures for [project], informing [plan/report].
Supported [annual work plan/budget tracking/project schedule] for [project], monitoring [costs/milestones] using [software] ([hours] hrs/week).
interview_questions: Tell us about a time you gathered information from multiple people to understand how an organization works.
Describe a problem you analyzed and the solution you recommended; how did you support it with data?
How do you prioritize competing deadlines on a team project?
How have you persuaded someone to cooperate when they were initially resistant?
watch_outs: Daniel may be ineligible if a degree was earned more than two years before appointment or if Daniel holds no degree.
The Secret clearance requirement means a background investigation and possible delays.
This is a public notice that may not have current vacancies, and placement can be at any Air Force location without telework.
The posting states an employee must receive written certification at the end of the probationary or trial period to stay employed.
